route_A.image_task: Create exactly one photo-only 3:4 portrait image of a real working rice granary in early morning. The scene must visibly contain pale rice grains, woven bamboo baskets, linen sacks, aged wooden grain bins, and a modest sorting/preparation table. Use believable documentary photography, cool-neutral morning daylight, realistic wood/cloth/rice materials, and one natural quiet low-detail area that could later hold typography. Do not include any people as the main subject, beauty/wellness products, bottles, cosmetics, supplements, laptops, home-office lifestyle scenes, tea ware, mountains/forest scenery, wok/fire, logos, labels, calligraphy, readable text, advertising copy, detached graphic panels, or invented brands. Use the attached R1C image only for overall visual family feeling and relational balance; do not copy its subject, brand, text, motifs, or layout.

compact_vpd_controls: One dominant material mass counterbalanced by a scene-created quiet tonal pocket.
Clear first-second-third read through dominant mass, depth layer and supporting process detail.
Concentrate high material detail regionally; keep the typography pocket visually low-density.
Preserve truthful near/mid/far depth rather than flattening the scene into a decorative still life.
Use pale grain, linen and aged wood with cool-neutral shadow roles; do not copy the reference palette literally.
Bind rice, baskets, sacks and tools to real process/material evidence rather than decorative motifs.
